description: This Java class provides a provider for version control related queue producers in the Thingsboard server, implementing methods to retrieve specific message producers and initializing some of them, while throwing exceptions for unsupported message types.

classes.name: TbVersionControlProducerProvider
classes.description: A provider class for creating and managing queue producers related to version control in Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the queue producers for core notifications, usage stats, and housekeeper.

methods.name: getTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; not used by version control service.

methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; not used by version control service.

methods.description: Throws RuntimeException; not used by version control service.

methods.name: getTbVersionControlMsgProducer
